description:
NodeFeature resource holds the features discovered for one node in the
cluster.

apiVersion.description:
APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object.
Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and
may reject unrecognized values.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description:
Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents.
Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to.
Cannot be updated.
In CamelCase.
More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

features.description: Features is the full "raw" features data that has been discovered.

additionalProperties.description: AttributeFeatureSet is a set of features having string value.
FlagFeatureSet is a set of simple features only containing names without values.
Nil is a dummy empty struct for protobuf compatibility
InstanceFeatureSet is a set of features each of which is an instance having multiple attributes.

items.description: InstanceFeature represents one instance of a complex features, e.g. a device.

labels.description: Labels is the set of node labels that are requested to be created.
